chunks: “Indeed, when the pilgrim performs sa‘y between al-Safa and al-Marwah, he comes out of his sins.”

key_terms.الصَّفَا: al-Safa, one of the two sacred points of sa‘y
key_terms.الْمَرْوَةِ: al-Marwah, the other sacred point of sa‘y
key_terms.ذُنُوبِهِ: his sins, from which he is cleansed
key_terms.سَعَى: performed sa‘y, the ritual walking between Safa and Marwah

ai.seo_question: What is the virtue of performing sa‘y between al-Safa and al-Marwah in hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith states the spiritual merit of performing sa‘y between al-Safa and al-Marwah during hajj. It teaches that this act of worship is a means for the pilgrim to be cleansed of sins.
